records.contract_sub_section: Service Level Standard Failure and Service Level Fee Credits
Service Level Standard Failure and Service Level Fee Credits
Service Level Standard Failure and Service Level Fee Credits
records.calculation: The Service Level Fee Credit provided to Walmart by Vendor for any Measurement Period shall be equal to: (A) the sum of: (I) the total number of Initial SLS Failures during such Measurement Period, multiplied by the Initial Fee Credit, plus (II) the total number of Continuing SLS Failures during such Measurement Period, multiplied by the Continuing Fee Credit, multiplied by (B) the total number of Vehicles Walmart had enrolled in the Fleet Services Program (identified in Section 2(l) of the Statement of Work for Fleet Management Services and Online Tools) during such Measurement Period.
records.example: For example, in a Measurement Period in which Walmart had nine thousand four hundred (9,400) Vehicles enrolled in the Fleet Services Program during such Measurement Period and there were four (4) Initial SLS Failures and four (4) Continuing SLS Failures, Vendor would owe Walmart a Service Level Fee Credit of $28,200 (being equal to (((4 x $0.25) + (4 x $0.50)) x 9,400). The Service Level Fee Credit for each Measurement Period will be provided to Walmart on the next invoice following the end of such Measurement Period. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the total amount of all Service Level Fee Credits provided by Vendor to Walmart in any Credit Year shall not exceed eighty-thousand ($80,000). (“Maximum Service Level Fee Credit”).

records.description: FleetView Web is a hosted web service that allows Walmart to view a combination of cross-fleet views on individual Drivers and Vehicles;

DriverView is a limited-scope web application providing read-only information about a single fleet Vehicle to its assigned driver, as well as limited transaction capability to a Driver eligible to drive a fleet Vehicle;
FleetView Mobile is mobile application available on IOS and Android devices accessing the same data as FleetView Web and providing a subset of capabilities to fleet managers while on-the-go; and

Wheels Mobile Assistant is a mobile application available on IOS and Android devices accessing the same data as FleetView Web and providing a set of capabilities to Drivers of fleet Vehicles (including Vehicle insurance and registration detail, as well as GPS-enabled trip logging).
